description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding one mana of any color.
Blood Artist trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield triggering Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger by losing one life and adding {B}.
Repeat.
